card.name: Words inside patient warning instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words inside instructions telling patients or caregivers to call, tell, or watch for something, such as "away" in "right away", "if", "for", "to", "all". Found in stimulant and similar drug-label patient sections.

modes.label: After call right
modes.description: The word "away" or the following "if" in "Call your doctor right away if".
modes.example: Call your doctor right<< away>> if you or your child has any signs

modes.label: Tell provider phrasing
modes.description: Linking words in "tell your healthcare provider if/about all your medical conditions".
modes.example: tell your healthcare provider about<< all>> your medical conditions, including if you:

modes.label: Advise to watch for
modes.description: Words in prescriber advice to be alert for or report early signs of a symptom.
modes.example: Advise patients and/or caregivers to be alert<< for>> changes in behavior or new NP symptoms when
